_meta.page_title: Cannabis, Hemp, and CBD Products: HMTc Program Manual
_meta.description: The Cannabis, Hemp, and CBD Products Program Manual for Category 25: metal-safety limits, lot testing, and the standards register.
_meta.scholar_abstract: The Cannabis, Hemp, and CBD Products Program Manual is the Category 25 instrument of Heavy Metal Certified. The publisher is the Institute of Contaminant Standards. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.cannabis-hemp-and-cbd-products is reserved for deposit and is not yet assigned. The Manual binds the six live subcategory standard pages; those pages remain the derivation of each cell. Inorganic arsenic is capped at total arsenic and tested on the program retest schedule. It does not carry a separate number, and it never replaces the parent. Methylmercury is capped at total mercury and tested on the program retest schedule. It does not carry a separate number, and it never replaces the parent. Hexavalent chromium is capped at total chromium and tested on the program retest schedule. It does not carry a separate number, and it never replaces the parent. Certification is metal safety only. It does not certify efficacy, legality, or approval status. A product is certified only when every published limit is met at or below 100 percent. The program certifies only when there is at least 90 percent confidence the brand can remain in the program. All rights reserved.
_meta.scope_lead_html: This manual states how Category 25 Cannabis, Hemp, and CBD Products is certified for metal safety. It does not certify efficacy, legality, or approval status. Inorganic arsenic is capped at total arsenic and tested on the program retest schedule. It does not carry a separate number, and it never replaces the parent. Methylmercury is capped at total mercury and tested on the program retest schedule. It does not carry a separate number, and it never replaces the parent. Hexavalent chromium is capped at total chromium and tested on the program retest schedule. It does not carry a separate number, and it never replaces the parent. Every figure in the matrix is read from the live standard record. Nothing in this manual invents a ceiling.
_meta.manual_method_note: The six live standards remain the derivation of each cell. A product is certified only at or below 100% of every published ceiling. The v1 PDF carries the program rules and the standards register, including each house DOI.
_meta.matrix_note: All values are ppb (µg/kg), in the row's basis. Click any subcategory for its derivation. A dash is a species capped at its parent total (inorganic arsenic at total arsenic, methylmercury at total mercury, hexavalent chromium at total chromium) and tested on the program retest schedule. It is not an empty cell and not an invented number.
_meta.risk_note_html:
Certification is decided on the product's own tested lot against the published ceiling. The limit is that ceiling on the live standard. Occurrence data do not set it. An individual lot can still exceed a limit.

See the cross-category summary.
_meta.rail_body: Manual v1 current (2026-10-15, Method v2.0). Six subcategory standards, each with a house DOI. The v1 PDF is downloadable here. The manual DOI suffix hmtc.manual.cannabis-hemp-and-cbd-products is reserved for deposit. cert_doi on this page stays empty until that deposit.
_meta.edition_pdf_line: The Manual v1 PDF is downloadable from the rail. Its program text and standards register match this page. The live subcategory pages remain the derivation of each cell. The manual DOI is not deposited yet.
